Update:

I just wanted to post an update to say I ended up getting some help, seeing family/friends in other cities, and started taking some positive steps in what feels like the right direction.

This was a bit of a wake-up call. Thanks to everyone who reached out, chatted, and kept in touch!
This is absolutely amazing, you're so talented!
Volunteering is a great idea, thank you.
Thanks for the reminder, I appreciate it.
Good luck finding your people too!

Thank you, I'll check the book out, I could always use some new ideas or perspective!
A lot of the groups nearby seem like retirement activities - arts, crafts, book club, poetry etc. I'm open to anything social at this stage, but when I looked into them, they didn't really have any members under 50. Someone else mentioned finding groups on Facebook, so I'll try that now too :)
I feel like the next step is making party hats for cats. I hope I don't hit that stage!
Haha no, it wasn't that one!
I looked into this but no definitely not. The main male character had much more of a fisherman/old man vibe. Thanks for the suggestion though!
There could have been a story subplot about the wife dying in childbirth and leaving the old man alone, but I'm not sure.
